payload.body: Fondations transverses du backlog geo-lib (osmnx-en-Node + Cityweft OSS): GeometryKernel, StreetGraph, harnais de parité, ModelRouter multi-modèles (Mistral OCR + panel 5.5/4.8), CAS compute-only. Réf: ../geo-quebec/studies/geo-backlog-unifie.md + archi-decisions.md.
payload.title: LOT 0 — Fondations & contrats (geo-lib)
WP0.1 — GeometryKernel (interface + adapters turf/proj4/GEOS-WASM) + corpus golden géométrie
WP0.2 — StreetGraph: modèle multigraphe dirigé (CRS, géométries, poids) + contrats sérialisation
WP0.3 — Harnais de parité: golden fixtures figées, zéro runtime Python, budgets perf, peering
WP0.4 — ModelRouter: routage capacité (ocr→Mistral, reason→panel 5.5+4.8), sorties zod
WP0.5 — geo-cache CAS: clé logique 2 niveaux + contentHash, frontière public/privé

payload.body:
- [ ] Build a deterministic local-only staging runner for Saint-Amable's 109 official zoning features and 109 linked PDF grids.
- [ ] Preserve every regulatory column as a variant and emit no production write capability.

- [x] Keep S3, live API, Track publication, manifests and deployment outside the runner.
- [x] Abort on source-fence drift, missing/duplicate source records, invalid PDF integrity or extraction ambiguity.
- [x] Preserve unrelated shared-worktree changes.
- [x] Require deterministic manifests and explicit diagnostic output on every failure.
payload.title: BR-1 — Saint-Amable official staging
Source fence and PDF manifest

payload.statement: UAT: deterministic 109-record content manifest for recorded fixtures; zero network mutation paths

payload.title: Native variant extraction

payload.statement: UAT: exact variant counts and expected height ranges; zero synthetic zone or structural usage

payload.title: Deterministic local staging runner

payload.statement: UAT: same inputs reproduce the same manifest SHA-256; runner imports no S3 client and exposes no publish flag

Deux passes independantes (47 villes puis 25) confirment que la re-materialisation n'est pas le levier. Arrive APRES les octets: la densite qualifie ce qu'un reglement a change, elle ne fait pas exister le lien.
